title: The Lock-Screen Lurker Test
description: Do you read texts from the lock screen to avoid opening them? Find out what kind of avoider you really are!

questions.text: A message pops up on your lock screen. First thought?

choices.label: "What do they mean? I need time to think!"
"Ugh, people. I'm too tired for this."
"I'll reply later." (Narrator: They won't)
"Not urgent. I'll reply when I'm ready."

questions.text: When do you finally open the chat?

choices.label: When my reply is perfectly drafted in my head.
In 3 to 5 business days.
When I accidentally tap the notification.
When I'm officially free from chores.
Panic! What do they want?!
Zero energy to ask what's up. Ignore.
Swipe away. I need more context to care.
Leave unread. They'll spit it out eventually.

questions.text: What's your excuse when you finally reply?

choices.label: "OMG so sorry, I was super busy!" (A lie)
"Sorry, I was napping." (True)
"I swear I replied in my head!"
No excuse. I just reply normally.
My anxiety would finally vanish!
Wouldn't fix my low social battery.
I'd still forget to reply anyway.
I don't care. I ignore them regardless.
